name: Insta Relations Manager
description: A 100% private, client-side web application to track who doesn't follow you back on Instagram, identify fans you don't follow back, and view pending follow requests without entering credentials.
featureList: Find who doesn't follow you back on Instagram
Discover accounts you don't follow back
100% local in-browser processing with zero server uploads
Instant search and sorting by username or timestamp
Safe and private with no Instagram password or login needed
